title: CLAIM: Snowden was a CIA plant running coded ops
summary: Q-drop-era claim that the whistleblower was a CIA-planted operative. No primary source — no document, testimony or investigative file — supports it; the public record is the disclosure archive itself.
tldr: The Wikipedia overview documents Snowden as the ex-NSA contractor who leaked the 2013 surveillance disclosures — nothing in it supports the 'CIA plant' theory.
ai_summary:
AI review of Wikipedia's 'Global surveillance disclosures (2013–present)' overview, read in full:
- Describes the reports as relating to 'top secret documents leaked by ex-NSA contractor Edward Snowden'; the first documents were published in June 2013, with further selected releases to news outlets through the year.
- The documents are intelligence files relating to the US and other Five Eyes countries; the ACLU hosts a complete archive of all released documents.
- Nothing in the overview supports the claim that Snowden was a CIA-planted operative running coded operations — no such theory, document, or testimony appears anywhere in it.
- Record summary's evidence-first stance verified: the public record documented here is the disclosure archive itself, with no primary source for the plant claim.
